statement: A line returns on 2 or more spreads in 4 of 6 books with text ('It's not me, Mama. It's Mud!', 'Catch that cat!', 'No, Amahle, you are too young.', a polite refusal in Best Friends); the other 2 repeat a failed-attempt structure instead of a line.

scope.population: contemporary open-licence picture books (Book Dash, South Africa, 2021-2025)

analyst_note: 2026-10-14: Best Friends and An Unexpected Adventure (wordless) reviewed for this claim. Best Friends repeats a refusal line on 3 spreads, then reverses it by action rather than changing the line. The wordless book is not counted.

magicpaper.current: repetition is measured as a defect to avoid (PROSE_PRODUCTION_GUIDE.md)
magicpaper.suggested: Distinguish deliberate refrains (a line the listener can join, changed once at the end) from accidental repetition before treating all repetition as a defect.
